data_facts_with_para.paragraph: According to research completed by Exploding Topics, 77% of companies are either using or exploring the use of AI in their businesses, and 83% of companies claim that AI is a top priority in their business plans.

facts.fact_content: 77% of companies are either using or exploring the use of AI in their businesses.
83% of companies claim that AI is a top priority in their business plans.
